notes.title: Big Demo Update + Full Game Sneak Peek
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We’ve been cooking up a lot of improvements for the demo and sneaking in some shiny new features for the full game too. One of the biggest fixes this round: input and device join bugs on Steam Remote Play Together are now resolved.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525505/ead96051495f0f9c2cab9671d34b2c6cf4281c65.png"]

On top of that, our Steam page got a bit of a facelift. Here’s the full breakdown:


DEMO GOODIES
Help Menu added to *Chronicles*

3 New Characters to try out

Recipe balance pass – smoother resource management

Reward System – collect stars on maps to unlock recipes, maps, and characters

Input Fixes

First input now sets your main device in menus

Device rejoin issues fixed

Fixed input and device join bugs on Steam Remote Play Together

Sale Cards rebalanced

Tutorials improved for better clarity

New audio and music tweaks

New menu animations

New menu font for easier readability

“Time’s Up” text added when the level ends

Flying coins animation when you score

Pause Menu added

Lots of smaller bugfixes



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525505/f6ece2c17cc69466acb1189c3f4f1f47ffd1d36a.png"]


FULL GAME SNEAK PEEKS
We’re experimenting with some wild new mechanics for the upcoming maps:

Ghosts that will haunt you

An angry octopus who might just eat you

Portals and a bunch of other surprises

New environment models


STEAM PAGE FACELIFT
Brand new Key Art

Updated Capsule Images



That’s all for now! Thanks a ton for playing, testing, and giving us feedback — it helps us shape this game into something truly fun (and a little chaotic). More updates are on the way, so stay tuned!

If you’d like to chat with us, share feedback, or just hang out with the community, join our Discord: https://discord.gg/rVaJycYyTN

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1.19 – July Improvements and Behind-the-Scenes Progress
notes.content:
Demo Update - 0.1.19

Hello everyone! We've just released a new demo update with several improvements based on your feedback. Here’s what’s changed:

Gameplay Updates

Character selection now sticks – no need to re-pick your favorite after every level.

Level adjustments on a1.3 and a1.4 – more room to move around, and it’s a bit harder to fall off the edge.

Tweaked demo level settings – more time and fewer points required to earn stars.

Interface & Visual Polish

New body text font for easier reading.

More consistent font sizes across the UI.

Partially hidden recipes – undiscovered ones now only hide a few ingredients and the score. Only a small number are fully hidden.

Tabs now have proper names in the Chronicles screen.

Throwing & Feel

Slower spinning when throwing objects – makes things feel more predictable and easier to follow.

Other Fixes

A round of general bug fixes and small polish improvements.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525505/3eecba000548d5aff22c882054cd21b4fe5845cd.png"]

A quick progress update: While the demo levels remain the same for now, development is moving steadily! We’ve completed 15 levels and currently have 5 more in progress. Our goal is to ship 25 main levels - 5 per acts, plus 5 to 7 optional extras.

Lastly, we’d love to invite you to join our Discord community! That’s where we’ll be chatting with players, sharing behind-the-scenes updates, and looking for beta testers in the near future.

Thanks for playing and for all the feedback so far – we really appreciate it! – The Artifactory Team

notes.title: 🎮 Demo Drop! The Artifactory is Now Playable 🎉
notes.content:
🎉 The Artifactory Demo is LIVE! 🎉

[previewyoutube=HqxobcVevb8;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey Lootmasters!
We’re thrilled to announce that our demo is now live and ready for action!

What’s in the demo?

 5 unique maps – Each with its own chaos, quirks, and conveyor belt madness
 Experimental resources – Mix, match, and discover new recipes on the fly
 Solo or up to 4-player co-op – Play alone or team up in local couch co-op

💬 We’d love your feedback – share your thoughts, bugs, and best packaging fails with us right here on the Community page!

Let the tinkering begin.

notes.title: Dev Update – New Levels, Fresh UI, and a Sneak Peek at Multiplayer Chaos!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've been hard at work behind the scenes, and it's time to share some juicy updates on The Artifactory! Things are really starting to take shape, and we’re beyond excited to show you what’s new.

Here’s what we’ve been up to:
Tutorial System
We’ve added a proper tutorial to help you get started! There are 3 tutorial levels now to ease you into the madness.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525505/b88ebe4b016a121751b4e7b40f615eaffa548669.jpg
New Levels

 3 tutorial maps 
 5 additional playable levels 

The upcoming demo will feature 5 hand-picked levels to try!

Save System
You asked, we listened. Progress now saves!

Menus, Glorious Menus
We’ve reworked and added tons of UI screens:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525505/294fa28a7cc92a1f50a4862fcea1910971f17043.jpg

 Main Menu
 Level Selector
 Brand-new “Cookbook” screen
 Lobby & End Game screens
 Craftsmans Chronicles
 Tutorial UI
 And a refreshed in-game UI 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525505/d4f3a8e368dad3f69a4b0b9223be4027760e43ba.jpg

Gameplay Improvements

 We tweaked the core loop to feel smoother and snappier.
 New Generator mechanic: if the generator runs out, conveyors stop—so keep that baby fueled!
 Reworked how interactions work so it’s way clearer what’s going to happen when you press a button.


Performance Boosts

 Optimized a bunch of systems so your gameplay stays buttery smooth.
 Fixed a ton of bugs and cleaned up early code that just wasn’t cutting it anymore.


New Content

 4 new craftable items (made from existing materials)
 1 new workstation type: the Runestone Bench
 2 new playable characters + brand-new animations
 Loads of fresh environment assets (models, textures, shaders, you name it)
 New music and sounds to bring your factory to life

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525505/183f7f1f756aee3cbfc62094d54550b21ea71b44.jpg

Demo Incoming!
We’ll be releasing a limited-time demo soon (not the Next Fest version yet, but a taste of what’s coming). Stay tuned!

New Gameplay Video Alert!
We’ve recorded a brand new multiplayer session with 3 players on a never-before-seen level—one that didn’t make it into the trailer. Check it out below 👇

[previewyoutube=0LAbg9BeiL8;full][/previewyoutube]

👉 So, what do you think of the new Generator feature? Or have a favorite factory theme you'd love to see in the game? Drop your thoughts in the comments—we love reading them!

Thanks for sticking with us!
– The Berries Studios team 🍓
